# reSpeaker Flex FAQ

This page contains verified answers for the reSpeaker Flex.

## Documentation & Usage {#documentation-and-usage}

### Where can I download ReSpeaker Flex mechanical files? {#mechanical-cad-files}

**Applies to:** ReSpeaker Flex XVF3800 with a Linear-4 or Circular-4 microphone array

**Last verified:** 2026-08-31

Use the official Flex Resources section. It publishes DXF and STEP files for the Circular-4 and Linear-4 arrays.

**Prerequisites:**

- The exact microphone geometry used by the design

## Hardware Issues {#hardware-issues}

### What FPC cable is documented for the ReSpeaker Flex microphone array? {#fpc-cable-spec}

**Applies to:** The microphone-array connection between the core board and either array

**Last verified:** 2026-09-01

The official Flex guide documents a keyed 24-pin, 0.5 mm-pitch FPC interface and a 20 cm ribbon cable.

**Notes:**

- The current public page does not specify contact-end thickness.
